€900+ → furnished, modern, serviced apartments (the expensive ones you saw)

If you want economic, you should avoid serviced apartments and look at private landlords or standard long‑term leases.

🎯 1. Understand the market reality (Villach & Klagenfurt)

What you are competing with
- Demand is high for 2–3 room flats (singles, couples, small families).  
- Good listings on Willhaben often get 20–50 inquiries in the first 24 hours.  
- Many landlords prefer:
  - Long-term tenants
  - Stable income (pension is ideal)
  - Quiet, reliable, non-smoking tenants
  - No pets (unless explicitly allowed)

Typical prices
- Villach: €650–€950 warm for 2–3 rooms  
- Klagenfurt: €700–€1,050 warm for 2–3 rooms  
- Newer buildings: €900–€1,200 warm

⚡ 3. How to win the race (Carinthia is “first come, first served”)

Step A — Set up instant alerts
On Willhaben:
- Search → Filter (2–3 Zimmer, max price, lift, parking, etc.)  
- Click “Suchagent aktivieren”  
- Choose Sofort-Benachrichtigung (push/email)

You must react within 30–60 minutes of a new listing.

---

Step B — Prepare a “rental application package”
Send this immediately when you contact a landlord:

Your message (short, professional):
- Who you are (French pensioner, stable income)  
- Why you want Villach/Klagenfurt  
- Duration (long-term, reliable)  
- No pets / non-smoker (if true)  
- Phone number  
- When you can visit  

Attach:
- Proof of pension (one page)  
- Copy of ID  
- Short personal profile (1 page)  
- SCHUFA equivalent: In Austria, landlords accept:
  - Selbstauskunft (self-declaration)  
  - KSV-Auskunft (optional)

This makes you look more reliable than 90% of applicants.

---

Step C — Call, don’t just write
Carinthian landlords respond much faster to phone calls.

If the listing has a phone number:
- Call immediately  
- Say you are available today or tomorrow for a visit  

This increases your chances by 300%.

---

Villach

Klagenfurt

---

🧩 5. Negotiation strategy

You can negotiate:
- Move-in date  
- Parking  
- Small rent reduction (€20–50)  
- Furniture removal  

You cannot negotiate:
- Betriebskosten (Nebenkosten)  
- Deposit (Kaution) → usually 3 months rent

---

🛡️ 6. Avoid scams
Carinthia is relatively safe, but avoid:
- Landlords who refuse visits  
- Requests for deposit before viewing  
- Listings with too low prices  
- “I am abroad, I send keys by DHL” → scam

---

🧠 7. The winning workflow (summary)

1. Set Willhaben alerts for Villach + Klagenfurt  
2. React within 30 minutes  
3. Call immediately  
4. Send application package  
5. Visit same day or next day  
6. Decide quickly (good flats go in 24–48 hours)  
7. Sign contract (check Befristung, Kaution, Nebenkosten)
